create_video_llama3_processor: create a VideoLlama3Processor instance with image_processor, tokenizer, and video_processor for multimodal video-text inference
run_video_llama3_processor_call: run the VideoLlama3Processor __call__ method to tokenize images, videos, and text into input_ids and pixel_values for model input
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for given image and video sizes using _get_num_multimodal_tokens
post_process_image_text_to_text: post-process generated model outputs into decoded text strings with post_process_image_text_to_text
configure_video_llama3_processor_kwargs: configure VideoLlama3ProcessorKwargs with custom padding, return_mm_token_type_ids, and return_metadata settings
